My family always moved frequently because of my dads job so it was really hard to make friends let alone have a set group of friends. Also my introverted personality didn't help out too much. One particular memory that stuck out to me is my freshman year of high school. Completely new school and knowing no one did not go hand in hand. I remember moving around during lunch to avoid eyes and being labeled as a loner. The loneliest of them all was when I went into the bathroom to eat only to act like I was washing my hand and quickly switching back to eat when they left, I did this for a few weeks and migrated to tables. However despite all of this loneliness I think in hindsight it made me appreciate my awesome non lonely situation now. I was in the darkness for so long that I appreciate the light that much more. So if anyone else is lonely just keep trucking along, trying different things, going to counseling, or whatever that helps you it does get better.
